# Index

## Quick Reference Guide

### Essential Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `go run main.go` | Compile and run |
| `go build` | Build binary |
| `go test ./...` | Run tests |
| `go mod tidy` | Sync dependencies |
| `go fmt ./...` | Format code |
| `go vet ./...` | Check for issues |
